desc:
👋 Welcome to KPop Demon Hunters Color Bridge!
Only the fiercest Hunters make it to the end!

🎭 Play as Jinu, Zoey, and Rumi!
🧠 Run fast, find the right tile, and don't fall!
👫 Reach the end with friends to earn amazing rewards!
🚁 Unlock exclusive perks like helicopters and gears!

👍 Like the game to support us!
